reply: ls with time at low density and whose P-slope grows with time. The per-time-bin residuals were still 0.05–0.18 even with a cubic in P, so the time dependence is not captured by any polynomial or sinusoid I tried. The earlier candidates reached 6.8e-4 at best; this one improves on that only slightly.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P**2 + p[3]*t + p[4]*t*P + p[5]*t**2
            + p[6]*t**2*P + p[7]*t**3 + p[8]*P*np.log(P) + p[9]*t*P*np.log(P))
